Folio — the palettes, from the app

Every colour on this page is read out of FolioArtDirection.kt and drawn through the same pipeline the app uses — the board's role chips and the Home renders alike. Nothing here comes from sheet.py, so this is what ships, not the proposal it came from.

20 faces: the nine sheet families plus the System pair. The strip under each screen is the face's own role set, in the order the board prints them. The plate is the current prototype and is known to be mid-rework — read the palettes, not the engraving.
